turns.said: Hello. How do I register for a TIN number with URA?
assistant: To register for a TIN, visit the official URA web portal at https://ura.go.ug and navigate to **eServices** > **TIN Registration**. You'll need to complete the online application form. Are you registering as an individual or an organisation?

turns.said: What is the standard VAT rate in Uganda?
assistant: The standard Value Added Tax (VAT) rate in Uganda is 18%. This is charged on taxable supplies of goods and services.

turns.said: Nnyinza ntya okwewandiisa okufuna TIN yange okuva mu URA?
assistant: Akaseera katono.

Okwewandiisa okusasula omusolo gwa V-A-T, omuntu alina okutuukiriza ebisaanyizo bya V-A-T eby'obukadde bwa siringi 37.5 buli mwaka. Okwewandiisa kwetaagibwa singa emiwendo gy'ebyamaguzi egisasulirwa omusolo gya kka waggulu ku bukadde buno. Okusaba kulina okuweebwayo mu nnaku 20 ng'omuwendo gw'ebyamaguzi ogusasulirwa omusolo gukka waggulu ku bukadde buno. Oyagala okumanya ebisingawo?
